title: Grateful Dead Live at Kresge Plaza - MIT on 1970-05-06
lineage: Panasonic SV-3700 > Cardas cable S/PDIF > Edirol UA-5 > analog out > Korg MR-1 DFF @ [1bit/2.8 mhz] Rate Conversion: AudioGate to [24bit/96 khz] Mastering: In WaveLab with Nomad Factory Plugins Rate Conversion with r8brain to [16bit/44.1 mhz] > TLH > Flac
source: Master Soundboard Reels 10", 2-sided, 1/2 Track Mono > DAT x 1

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a concise early‑May 1970 set that captures electrifying Jerry work and standout performances of “Dancin’ in the Streets,” “Morning Dew” and “Good Lovin’,” with a clear mix and only a minor flow hiccup between songs.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the show’s energy, highlighting the soaring guitar on Dancin' in the Streets, the emotive delivery of Morning Dew, and the tight vocal harmonies throughout. The soundboard source is generally clear and well‑balanced, though one reviewer notes a small edit between St. Stephen and Not Fade Away that slightly disrupts the flow. Overall the performance is praised as a powerful snapshot of the Dead’s early‑May 1970 vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars and emphasize strong musical moments; recording is a soundboard with good clarity, only minor technical blemish, leading to a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear mix with crisp harmonies and strong instrument separation; a subtle edit between St. Stephen and Not Fade Away is noted as the only noticeable issue.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short, tight set packed with high‑energy numbers and seamless transitions, aside from a minor cut between St. Stephen and Not Fade Away that slightly hurts the flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as a “self‑generating source of electricity” with a long solo on Good Lovin' and intense playing throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for his prominent bass on Morning Dew, early return to the mix on Good Lovin', and letting loose during the set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted sharing vocal duties on Dancin' in the Streets and other numbers; provides rhythm support.
band_member_comments.Drums: Praised for a strong intro on Good Lovin' and keeping the tempo warm as musicians warmed their hands.
